{{Quote|You remain silent if you wish. But if Luke Skywalker needs help saving the galaxy from this plague, the least I can do is show him where to start looking.|Sanar to Najee|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
'''Sanar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pydyrian]] who worked as a subordinate to the portmaster of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]] in [[44 ABY]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pydyrian]], Sanar was employed at a port on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Pydyr]]. A subordinate of [[Portmaster/Legends|Portmaster]] [[Najee]], Sanar was working at the port when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[New Jedi Order]], arrived on the moon in [[44 ABY]]. At the time, Sanar and other port staff were under strict orders to restrict all access to the moon as an unknown, seemingly contagious plague had broken out across the populace. Despite the quarantine, Master Skywalker insisted he be allowed to move about the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], as he was searching the mysterious entity called [[Abeloth]] and believed her to have recently landed on the world.<ref name="Vortex" />

Seeking Sanar's cooperation when faced with a defiant Najee, Skywalker urged the man to let him, his son [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], and their acquaintance [[Vestara Khai]] pass through the port. Despite threats from Najee, Sanar could not bring himself to deny the famous [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and allowed them to pass undisturbed out of the port and provided the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with information that aided them in finding Abeloth and ending the plague; which was in fact simply an illusion created through the [[White Current/Legends|White Current]].<ref name="Vortex" />
